responseMessageContents.text:
The user is saying that the UI looks correct in the Rork preview but not on the iOS version (the actual device via QR code). This is likely a build/staleness issue — the latest changes haven't been rebuilt and deployed to the cloud simulator that the QR code points to.

Let me check what the current state of the file is and then rebuild to push the latest changes.
Let me check the current file and rebuild so your QR code picks up the latest changes.

The build passed. The issue is that the QR code in the Rork App loads the last built version. Now that I've run `runChecks`, the build is fresh and the QR code should point to the latest version with all the changes.

But the user says the preview looks right but the iOS version doesn't. This could mean:
1. They haven't refreshed the Rork App on their phone after the build
2. There could be platform-specific differences between the web preview (iframe-based React Native preview) and the actual iOS build

Let me suggest they refresh/reload the Rork App on their phone to pick up the latest build.

The build just completed successfully. Your QR code should now show the latest version with all the spacing fixes. Try **pulling down to refresh** in the Rork App on your phone, or **kill and reopen** it — the QR code doesn't auto-update, so it may have been showing an older build.
